label: preserved-artifact
what: Raw per-window family-sweep artifacts for CW 9i window 10 (b-cw9i-10), committed 2026-08-12 under RULES #12 and #23. These are the inputs a third party needs to re-derive that window's family assignments from pipeline/family/assemble_sweep.py.
provenance: copied unchanged from pipeline/work/ (gitignored). The equivalent artifacts for windows 8 and 9 did NOT survive — pipeline/work/ holds one sweep at a time and each window overwrote the last. Their assignments live in seed.json; their raw arm votes do not exist anywhere and are not reconstructible.
verified: Replaying these two arm files through the agreement rule reproduces the merged graph exactly: 30 agreements assigned, 4 disagreements queued, and all four queue entries in pipeline/work/family_pending_queue.json carry the arms' own words verbatim. Checked 2026-08-12 before committing.
corpus_channel: Quotes here are the verified <=25-letter-token excerpts (longest in this set: 24). Publishable channel, per RULES #20.
